title: check-id-collisions assigns rows a value it always overwrites (CodeQL alert 289)
detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-09-29. MEASURED: CodeQL raised js/useless-assignment-to-local on #3040 at scripts/check-id-collisions.mjs treeIdSets: `let rows = new Set()` is overwritten on both the try and the catch path, so the initial value is dead. #3040 merged before the fix landed. WHAT CLOSED IT: `let rows` is declared without an initial value; behaviour is unchanged (both paths still assign it). Filed as a ledger fragment (ADR-1635).

verify.note: Fails if treeIdSets gives rows an initial value again (the alert), and if treeIdSets stops returning the merged row and ADR sets. Fails on main at e2f8f3226.
